name: RAINBOW
description: Commonsense AI has long been seen as a near impossible goal -- until recently. Now, research interest has sharply increased with an influx of new benchmarks and models. We propose two new ways to evaluate commonsense models, emphasizing their generality on new tasks and building on diverse, recently introduced benchmarks. First, we propose a new multitask benchmark, RAINBOW, to promote research on commonsense models that generalize well over multiple tasks and datasets. Second, we propose a novel evaluation, the cost equivalent curve, that sheds new insight on how the choice of source datasets, pretrained language models, and transfer learning methods impacts performance and data efficiency. typical_sota_score: 70–95% (varies widely by subtask and dataset included in the multitask suite)
reputation: RAINBOW is an influential early multitask commonsense benchmark that helped motivate broader transfer and generalization evaluation.
notes: Composed of multiple existing commonsense datasets, so results can be affected by dataset overlap and transfer-learning setup; not a single-task benchmark.
